title: {{NAME}} and the Roaring Royal Rescue
moral: Being brave and kind together makes any problem small.

pages.content: {{NAME}} lived near a big, bright castle. The castle had tall pink towers and a golden gate. One morning, {{NAME}} put on his red superhero cape. He was ready for an adventure. A loud roar came from the forest. It was a friendly dinosaur! The dinosaur was crying big, wet tears. Something was very wrong.

pages.content: {{NAME}} ran up to the dinosaur. The dinosaur was called Dino. Dino pointed a big claw at the castle. "Princess is stuck!" said Dino. "The castle gate is locked." {{NAME}}'s eyes went wide. He had to help! Being brave was what superheroes did. {{NAME}} felt his cape flutter in the wind.

pages.content: Inside the castle was a princess. The princess wore a bright blue dress and a golden crown. She had been locked in all morning. She looked very sad. {{NAME}} and Dino walked in and the princess smiled. "You saved me!" she said. {{NAME}} smiled back. Helping someone feel happy felt wonderful.
